movie.title: Sleepwalker
movie.overview: A grieving mother is haunted by the tragic loss of her daughter in a car accident that left her abusive husband in a coma. As she battles a surreal descent into darkness, her sleepwalking episodes intensify. Plagued by haunting visions of her husband inside their home, she grapples with the blurred lines between reality and nightmare.

reviews.author: Sierbahnn
reviews.content:
Technically proficient mess
This movie looks good. It sounds good. That does not make it good. It is disjointed (in a bad way), with rules that are not internally consistent (which is a grave sin when it comes to horror-movies) and it is simply not very engaging. You don't care about the characters, the constant shifts in time and feeling becomes draining, and after a while you just check out. The 10s here are not really sincere, but a way to push the ratings up a bit, I suspect. It is sad when a movie has to resort to this.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: Haunted by the car crash that killed her daughter and left her abusive husband in a coma, a grieving mother plunges into a nightmare as her violent sleepwalking blurs the line between trauma and reality.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Devastated by the tragic loss of her young daughter in a devastating automobile accident, a fragile mother attempts to piece her life back together. Her grief is compounded by the fact that her abusive husband survived the crash, albeit trapped in a comatose state. As she suffers from increasingly severe and violent sleepwalking episodes, terrifying visions of her husband begin to invade her home. Suspended in a surreal space between waking reality and hallucination, she must confront the dark secrets of her past before her nightmarish subconscious completely consumes her.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: In the emotional aftermath of a fatal car accident, a mother is left completely shattered by the death of her beloved daughter. The collision also leaves her estranged, abusive husband in a deep coma, trapping her in a complex state of grief, guilt, and lingering fear. Struggling to navigate life in her quiet, isolated home, her mental state rapidly deteriorates as severe sleepwalking episodes take hold. What begins as midnight wandering escalates into terrifying fugue states where she re-enables painful memories and acts out unseen horrors. Spectral visions and malevolent manifestations of her comatose husband start appearing throughout the house, forcing her to question her own sanity. Unsure if she is being haunted by a vengeful force or unraveling under the weight of unprocessed trauma, she desperately searches for answers. As the boundary separating her subconscious nightmares from waking life completely dissolves, nightfall becomes a psychological battleground. She is forced to navigate terrifying nocturnal hallucinations while uncovering the suppressed truth of what actually happened on the night of the crash. Ultimately, she must brave the darkest corners of her mind to break free from the abusive shadow that still controls her.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Sleepwalker is a harrowing blend of psychological thriller, horror, and drama that delves deep into the lingering scars of domestic trauma and grief. The story follows a grieving mother navigating the painful reality of a car accident that claimed her daughter's life while leaving her abusive husband comatose in a hospital bed. Alone in her home, the overwhelming strain of her trauma manifests as severe parasomnia, causing her to sleepwalk into increasingly dangerous situations. As her nocturnal episodes worsen, she experiences haunting, surreal visions of her comatose husband pursuing her through the shadows of her own house. The film masterfully blurs the boundary between horrific hallucination and waking reality, crafting an atmospheric journey through psychological disintegration, guilt, and the fight for emotional survival.
